finding.claim: StartActionByGet and StartActionByGetAndWait start actions without validateJustificationRequired, so justification-required actions run with an empty justification.
finding.source: Any caller (guest or authenticated) sending a GET request with an actionId to StartActionByGet or StartActionByGetAndWait.
finding.sink: executor.ExecRequest runs the action with no Justification; executor.go:1019 resolves to empty for non-system users.

trace.note: StartActionByGet builds ExecutionRequest with no Justification and calls ExecRequest.
StartActionByGetAndWait -> startActionByGetAndWaitLogEntry (360) -> runBindingAndWait (345) with no justification check.
StartAction and StartActionAndWait (306-311) call validateJustificationRequired; the GET handlers do not.
entry.Justification = ResolveJustification(req).
ResolveJustification falls back to defaults only for system usernames; returns empty for guest or user.

finding.guards_checked: Executor ACL stepACLCheck (executor.go:831-846) still applies, so execute permission is required. Only the justification requirement is bypassed. No justification check exists downstream of the handler.

finding.claim: Trusted-header auth accepts any client-supplied username and group header with no source check, letting direct clients impersonate any user and, via a provider header, skip the justification requirement.
finding.source: Any HTTP client that can reach the API when authHttpHeaderUsername is configured, sending the configured username header; the provider header is read unconditionally.
finding.sink: runAuthChain accepts the header identity as the authenticated user, so ACLs and group checks apply to the spoofed identity; provider=system makes IsSystemExecution true.

trace.note: checkUserFromHeaders reads username and group headers from the request.
provider header read unconditionally and assigned to Provider.
checkUserFromHeaders is first in authChain.
Any non-empty Username is accepted as the authenticated user.
IsSystemExecution returns true when Provider == system and Username != guest.
justificationProvided treats IsSystemExecution as satisfying the justification requirement.

finding.guards_checked: No check of request origin, trusted-proxy allowlist, or proxy header stripping. Only gate is non-empty username. Header auth must be explicitly configured.

finding.claim: PasswordHash has no authentication and runs argon2id at 64 MiB per call; concurrent calls exhaust the shared 10-slot semaphore and cause local login to fail with ResourceExhausted.
finding.source: Any unauthenticated API caller sending PasswordHash requests with arbitrary password values.
finding.sink: createHash holds one of 10 argon2Sem slots for each computation; LocalUserLogin shares the same semaphore.

trace.note: PasswordHash performs no auth check and calls createHash.
argon2MaxConcurrent = 10 shared semaphore.
defaultParams: 64 MiB memory, 4 iterations, parallelism NumCPU.
CreateHash acquires a semaphore slot or returns ErrArgon2Busy.
LocalUserLogin returns CodeResourceExhausted when the semaphore is busy.

finding.guards_checked: Semaphore limits concurrency but does not prevent a sustained attacker from holding slots. No per-caller limit or password size limit in this path.

finding.claim: GetEntity returns entity properties to any user passing the dashboard check, without applying the per-action view ACL that hides the same data elsewhere.
finding.source: Any user passing checkDashboardAccess, including guests unless AuthRequireGuestsToLogin is set, requesting an entity by type and uniqueKey.
finding.sink: buildEntityResponse returns title, key, directories and configured entity properties.

trace.note: GetEntity calls only checkDashboardAccess before lookup.
checkDashboardAccess gates only on guest login requirement.
buildEntityResponse invoked with the entity and config.
buildEntityResponse includes entity properties; rest of function not fully reviewed.
Contrast: dashboard actions are filtered by acl.IsAllowedView.

finding.guards_checked: Dashboard access check and per-action related-action filtering (api_entity_related_actions.go:56-58). GetEntities (api.go:1402) and the full buildEntityResponse body were not reviewed.

finding.claim: anchorCustomRegexPattern skips anchoring when a pattern starts with ^ and ends with $, so a top-level alternation lets unanchored values pass validation.
finding.source: A request argument value validated against an admin-authored regex: argument type.
finding.sink: typeSafetyCheckRegex accepts the value, which reaches exec argv.

trace.note: Pattern with ^ prefix and $ suffix is returned unchanged.
regexp.MatchString is unanchored, so ^A|B$ matches strings that start with A or end with B.
regex: types are rejected for shell actions, limiting impact to exec argv.

finding.guards_checked: Shell actions reject regex: types (arguments.go:381-388). Requires admin-authored pattern with top-level alternation.

finding.claim: StartActionByGet executes actions on a top-level cross-site GET, because session cookies are SameSite=Lax, which permits cookies on top-level GET navigation.
finding.source: A link or redirect on another site opened by a logged-in victim.
finding.sink: Action execution under the victim identity via StartActionByGet.

trace.note: StartActionByGet is a state-changing GET.
Local session cookie set with SameSite=Lax.
Logout cookies also Lax.

finding.guards_checked: Victim ACL applies, so only actions the victim may already run are reachable. Possibly intentional for trigger URLs.
